them.zh: UI UX Pro Max 做的

steps.en: Install the CLI and drop the skill into your project for your assistant
steps.zh: 装 CLI，为所用 agent 把 skill 落进项目
steps.code: npm install -g ui-ux-pro-max-cli · uipro init --ai claude

steps.en: Ask for UI work in natural language
steps.zh: 用自然语言提出 UI/UX 需求
steps.code: Build a landing page for my SaaS product

steps.en: Skill auto-activates and runs multi-domain BM25 search over its bundled CSV databases
steps.zh: skill 自动激活，对内置 CSV 库做多域 BM25 检索

steps.en: Reasoning engine matches product type to style, palette, fonts and anti-patterns
steps.zh: 推理引擎把产品类型映射到风格、配色、字体与反模式

steps.en: Runs the pre-delivery checklist (contrast, breakpoints, focus states, no emoji icons)
steps.zh: 交付前跑质量清单（对比度、断点、focus 状态、不用 emoji 图标）

value.en: Agent makes defensible design decisions - style, palette, typography, a11y - without you owning a design system first
value.zh: agent 做出有据可依的设计决策——风格、配色、排版、无障碍——你不必先自建一套设计系统

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09: Installation section `npm install -g ui-ux-pro-max-cli`, `uipro init --ai claude`; Example prompts `Build a landing page for my SaaS product`; Design System Command section `python3 .claude/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/scripts/search.py "SaaS dashboard" --design-system --persist -p "MyApp"`; How It Works + pre-delivery checklist sections; Features section (192 reasoning rules, BM25 per What's New diagram, Python 3.x stdlib-only per Prerequisites)
